body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). Four test files across hollow-test, gate-fuzzing, and quartermaster manually invoke mkdtempSync and guard removals in try/finally blocks, and are allowlisted in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs. With @adlc/core/test-kit (tmp, gitRepo), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via t.after when passed the test context t.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In packages/hollow-test/test/hollow-test.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp, gitRepo } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update tests to accept t parameter and allocate scratch repos / temp dirs via tmp(t) / gitRepo(t).
   - Remove manual try/finally cleanup blocks.
2. In packages/hollow-test/test/unit.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update tests creating temp directories to accept t and use tmp(t, 'hollow-rails-unit-').
   - Remove manual try/finally cleanup blocks.
3. In packages/gate-fuzzing/test/isolation.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp, gitRepo } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update makeSourceRepo(t) and candidate clones to use gitRepo(t, { prefix: 'gf-src-repo-' }) and tmp(t, 'gf-clone-').
   - Remove manual rmSync cleanup blocks.
4. In packages/quartermaster/test/registry-isolation.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update tests to accept t and replace mkdtempSync calls with tmp(t, prefix).
   - Remove manual try/finally cleanup blocks.
5. In scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs:
   - Remove packages/hollow-test/test/hollow-test.test.mjs, packages/hollow-test/test/unit.test.mjs, packages/gate-fuzzing/test/isolation.test.mjs, and packages/quartermaster/test/registry-isolation.test.mjs from ALLOWLIST (completely eradicates all 3 packages from the allowlist!).
6. Verification:
   - npm test -w packages/hollow-test && npm test -w packages/gate-fuzzing && npm test -w packages/quartermaster exits 0.
   - node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
   - grep -E 'packages/(hollow-test|gate-fuzzing|quartermaster)/test/' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs returns nothing.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 grep -E 'packages/(hollow-test|gate-fuzzing|quartermaster)/test/' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs returns nothing.
- AC2 npm test -w packages/hollow-test exits 0 with all tests passing.
- AC3 npm test -w packages/gate-fuzzing exits 0 with all tests passing.
- AC4 npm test -w packages/quartermaster exits 0 with all tests passing.
- AC5 node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC6 adlc rails-guard exits 0.
title: refactor(hollow-test): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit in hollow-test, gate-fuzzing, and quartermaster tests
